command:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 ai-core-node@100.70.87.28 'bash -s' <<'REMOTE_SCRIPT'
set -e
echo '=== current daemon key config ==='
grep -nE 'CONTROL_BRANCH|RESULTS_BRANCH|MACHINE|OWNER|POLL|def main|def execute|processed|sqlite|command_id|fetch|checkout|reset' ~/.claude/star/local_bridge_daemon.py | head -240 || true
echo '=== legacy daemon key config ==='
grep -nE 'CONTROL_BRANCH|RESULTS_BRANCH|MACHINE|OWNER|POLL|def main|def execute|processed|sqlite|command_id|fetch|checkout|reset' ~/.local/share/clay-local-bridge/bin/daemon.py | head -240 || true
echo '=== current daemon environment ==='
tr '\0' '\n' </proc/2563/environ | grep -E 'LOCAL_BRIDGE|HOME|USER|PATH' || true
echo '=== legacy daemon environment ==='
tr '\0' '\n' </proc/10510/environ | grep -E 'LOCAL_BRIDGE|HOME|USER|PATH' || true
echo '=== systemd user units matching bridge ==='
systemctl --user list-units --all --no-pager | grep -i bridge || true
echo '=== user crontab/process parent legacy ==='
ps -o pid,ppid,lstart,cmd -p 2563,10510 || true
REMOTE_SCRIPT
